svg.aria-label: Threat intel: dependency crates roll toward your app and the Dependency Auditor checks each one for known CVEs. One crate passes, until the Threat Intel Analyst x-rays it and finds an obfuscated install hook that steals environment variables and SSH keys. PYA flags it critical, maps it to MITRE ATT&CK supply chain, obfuscation and exfiltration techniques, and the three bots tag it do not ship.
